note: Rustic year-round Alberta Parks campground in Fisher Creek PRA, 12 km southwest of Bragg Creek on Hwy 66 and 15 km south on McLean Creek Road, run by Kananaskis Campground Services, with direct access to the McLean Creek OHV Public Land Use Zone. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Aug 13, 2026): year-round, first-come, 15 unserviced drive-in sites + 15 walk-in tent sites at C$31, vault toilets, non-potable pump; site count 30 -> 15 (drive-in only). OHV DROP CANDIDATE: the agency says the campground offers 'direct access to the McLean Creek Off-Highway Vehicle Public Land Use Zone'. Pads not located on imagery.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (OHV rule): the Alberta Parks page: 'A good base camp in the foothills for nearby hiking and snowmobiling, this campground offers a rustic camping experience and direct access to the McLean Creek Off-Highway Vehicle Public Land Use Zone.' The stored note also called it a 'Base camp for the McLean Creek OHV Public Land Use Zone'. The neighbouring McLean Creek campground's OHV loops were a drop candidate in p3-379. On imagery the directions point is a large gravel lot with a track running NW into the zone. The page does not say the sites themselves have trail access; reviewer's call.

PHONE: stored 403-949-3132 matches the page's 'Information: 403-949-3132'. 'Facility Operator: Kananaskis Campground Services Inc.'; its Elbow Valley page (https://www.kananaskiscampgrounds.com/valleys/elbow-valley) lists 'year-round options at McLean Creek Campground, Fisher Creek Campground, and River Cove Group Camp' but has no Fisher Creek section.
WEBSITE: stored Alberta Parks camping page answered 200 and is this campground.
SEASON: 'Season: Year-round' matches the stored manual season.
SENIORS LINE: PRESENT ('This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.').
KANANASKIS CONSERVATION PASS: the provincial:AB row exempts Fisher Creek PRA; the page does not mention the pass. Nothing written.

PIN (50.78891,-114.58514): in forest ~110 m south of the gravel lot and turnaround at the end of the access spur; the page's directions point 50.790941,-114.585401 is the gravel lot itself (~225 m north). Google's point 50.78913,-114.58240 lies on McLean Creek Trail ~200 m east. I could not see the 15 drive-in pads on Esri imagery (only the lot, a small turnaround and a southbound track), so I give no corrected point; if the pads are around the lot, the directions point is the better pin.
Google Maps: 4.4 from 22 reviews (no phone); website links the Alberta Parks page.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed (no water at the lot or pin).
